relations.product: SpaceMobile space-based cellular broadband service for AT&T end users in the continental U.S. (excluding Alaska) and Hawaii
relations.quote: We have entered into a space-based wireless connectivity agreement with AT&T to provide SpaceMobile Service to AT&T’s end users for use within the continental United States (excluding Alaska) and Hawaii.
relations.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K (03-02-2026)

relations.product: direct-to-cellular SpaceMobile service for Verizon customers in the continental U.S. and Hawaii from 2026 (definitive commercial agreement, October 2025)
relations.quote: On October 8, 2025, we announced the signing of a definitive commercial agreement with Verizon to provide direct-to-cellular AST SpaceMobile service when needed for Verizon customers within the continental United States (excluding Alaska) and Hawaii starting in 2026.
relations.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K (03-02-2026)

relations.product: SpaceMobile Services for Vodafone end users outside the markets covered by SatCo
relations.quote: We also have an agreement with Vodafone to provide SpaceMobile Services to Vodafone’s end users outside of the markets covered by our agreement with SatCo.
relations.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K (03-02-2026)

relations.product: exclusive reseller agreement (December 18, 2025): SatCo, the European satellite service business AST owns jointly with Vodafone, distributes SpaceMobile Service to MNOs in Europe, the UK and other markets
relations.quote: On December 18, 2025, we entered into a reseller agreement with our jointly-owned European satellite service business with Vodafone (“SatCo”) to exclusively distribute SpaceMobile Service to MNOs in Europe, UK and certain other markets.
relations.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K (03-02-2026)

relations.product: ten-year commercial agreement (October 29, 2025) for direct-to-device satellite mobile connectivity across Saudi Arabia and key regional markets
relations.quote: On October 29, 2025, we entered into a ten-year commercial agreement with Saudi Telecom Company (“STC”) to enable direct-to-device satellite mobile connectivity across Saudi Arabia and key regional markets.
relations.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K (03-02-2026)

relations.product: Amended and Restated Commercial Agreement with Rakuten Mobile (December 15, 2020)
relations.quote: Amended and Restated Commercial Agreement, dated as of December 15, 2020, by and between AST & Science, LLC and Rakuten Mobile Singapore PTE. LTD.
relations.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K (03-02-2026)

relations.product: usage rights for mid-band spectrum (Ligado Transaction)
relations.quote: Pursuant to the Ligado Transaction, we agreed to pay Ligado consideration totaling $550.0 million in cash
relations.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K (03-02-2026)

relations.product: testing services on the initial BlueBird satellites (contract through a prime contractor)
relations.quote: we entered into a contract with the United States Space Development Agency (“SDA”) through a prime contractor with total expected revenue of $43.0 million to provide certain testing services utilizing the initial BB satellites
relations.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K (03-02-2026)

relations.product: Europa Track 2 commercial solutions program (direct SDA agreement)
relations.quote: an agreement directly with the United States SDA for the Europa Track 2 commercial solutions program with a total contract value of approximately $30.0 million
relations.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K (03-02-2026)

relations.product: strategic relationship named in AST's 10-K (technologies, products and potential end-user customers complementing AST's strategy)
relations.quote: We have developed relationships with companies, such as Vodafone, Rakuten, AT&T, Verizon, Google, American Tower, STC, Bell Canada and others that have innovative technologies and products, skilled personnel, and potential end-user customers that complement our strategy.
relations.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K (03-02-2026)
